reviews.comment: I think that he is a very good professor, he just has a bit of a monotone way of speaking. He also canceled Friday classes quite often, so it leaves some free time for you to study on other subjects if you have to!
Lectures were boring but assignments were straightforward. Take this class if you're looking for an easy A. Nice guy, but doesn't always respond to emails promptly.

Lectures were very interesting but basically drew on the book (which I didn't end up using and was fine). The tests are pretty straightforward but specific, and I would say that the essays had fun prompts. Dr. Nutor's a great guy with so much archaeological experience that he sprinkles into his lectures, 10/10

Super sweet guy and very passionate about his work! Your grade is basically a few papers and a few tests, all of which are pretty simple/easily graded. The textbook didn't do a lot for me personally, so you should definitely go to class because you'll get all the exam info in the lecture slides. Definitely an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Theres four papers and some assignments, attendance is 5% of your grade so you can miss a few, people usually just mess around in class, he posts the lecture slides and exams are online. He's super chill, boring lectures but i feel for the guy because no one really pays attention. Easy A, sometimes the TA who grades your paper is a stickler.
He's really chill and nice. There are some short essays to write, but they arn't stressful as he is lenient on grading. I recommend him!

super easy prof, all exams were online and open book. He also ended class 20 mins early so that was nice, the only issue was the content was boring but with that easy of a class it did not really matter.

Dr. Nutor is an easy professor with a pretty light workload. We only had three tests and four short papers, all graded pretty lightly. The tests were online too, so not too much to worry about if you just skimmed the textbook and went to class. Overall, a nice professor and an easy A class.

Very easy professor. If you have to take a class to fulfil a communications credit or whatever, take this specific professor. He is an easy grader and requires minimal work. He may be boring but that doesnt matter because youll get an A

Dr. Nutor is incredibly boring. He has a thick accent which would be fine if he didn't talk at an inaudible level. He usually ends class 20 minutes early, however, they feel like they last for centuries. He grades super easily and the tests are online with a 2 hr time limit and 50 questions. He assigns essays without talking about them in class.
